findings.title: Missing Grease Interceptor Specifications
findings.obs: The grease interceptor detail refers to an external document for specifications ('Grease Interceptor-spec-sheet-pdf.pdf'), which is not present in this drawing.

findings.title: Inferred Fixture Schedule Reference
findings.obs: The keyed notes regularly reference a 'plumbing fixture schedule,' which is not visible on this sheet. The schedule might be on another sheet in the drawing set.

findings.title: Unclear Risk Category for Masonry
findings.obs: The table section for masonry on the 'SCHEDULE OF SPECIAL INSPECTIONS' does not specify the Building Risk Category beyond 'Masonry (Level ; Building Risk Category )'.

findings.title: Ductwork Demolition Clarity
findings.obs: The mezzanine and basement plans specify existing supply and return ductwork removal or retention, but lack specific demolition sequence or phasing information.

findings.title: Field Coordination Note
findings.obs: The note states: 'SANITARY SIZING AND LOCATION TO BE COORDINATED WITH ALL FIELD CONDITIONS PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION.'

findings.title: Grease Interceptor Details
findings.obs: The sheet notes: 'SEE DETAIL 1 ON DRAWING P-3.0 FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.'

findings.title: Travel Distance Calculation Review
findings.obs: The sheet includes a 'Travel Distance Calculation' labeled as N.T.S. (not to scale) with a stated maximum travel distance of 320 feet.

findings.title: Occupancy and Egress Capacity
findings.obs: Second floor occupancy calculations are noted with a maximum total of 80 persons and corresponding egress calculations.

findings.title: ADA Compliance Note
findings.obs: The drawing specifies locations for ADA-compliant seating areas and paths.

findings.title: Plan and Legend Coordination
findings.obs: The legend includes symbols for different door types and walls, which should be consistently applied across the plans.

findings.title: Parapet Fire Rating Verification
findings.obs: The drawing shows a parapet detail at the vestibule without a specified fire rating.

findings.title: Specification appears in the cited evidence
findings.obs: The cited drawing evidence already includes specification content related to this topic. A missing-specification conclusion is not established from that evidence alone.

findings.title: Architectural and Structural Coordination
findings.obs: Architectural wall section details reference existing structural elements without specifying modifications.

findings.title: Sealing Recommendations for Canopy Junctions
findings.obs: Detail for canopy attachment calls for specific manufacturer attachment details but does not show sealing methods.

findings.title: Lack of Backflow Prevention Details
findings.obs: The drawing mentions connections to backflow preventers for soda systems (TAG #031.03P4), but lacks detailed specifications or information on backflow prevention devices.

findings.title: Verify In Field (VIF) Notations
findings.obs: Multiple items in the plumbing schedule specify 'VERIFY IN FIELD' for installation heights and connections.

findings.title: General Glazing Notes
findings.obs: The sheet contains general glazing notes for doors and windows, specifying the need for compliance with safety standards but lacks detailed section references or specifications for

findings.title: Date Discrepancy
findings.obs: Revision date '10/15/26' is in the future compared to analysis date '2026-10-29'.

findings.title: Specific Equipment Brand Requirement
findings.obs: The notes specify 'NO SUBSTITUTIONS PERMITTED' for Accurex equipment.

findings.title: Interlock with Hood
findings.obs: Fan units are to be interlocked with warewasher switching contact.

findings.title: Hood/Fan Interlock Details Reference
findings.obs: The drawing refers to another sheet for hood/fan interlock details.

findings.title: Missing Expansion Tank Schedule
findings.obs: The general plumbing notes refer to an expansion tank schedule that is not included on this sheet.

findings.title: Backflow Prevention Device Types
findings.obs: Notes specify different types of backflow preventers without specific device types confirmed as per local codes.

findings.title: Inconsistent Sheet Title Formatting
findings.obs: The sheet is titled "2ST FLOOR EQUIPMENT PLAN" which appears to be a typographical error for "2ND FLOOR EQUIPMENT PLAN".

findings.title: Insufficient Labeling on Lighting Layout
findings.obs: The lighting layout lacks sufficient labeling for fixture types in some sections.

findings.title: Monitor Installation Detail Clarification Needed
findings.obs: The monitor installation detail (Detail 9) does not clearly specify structural support requirements.
